verdict.rationale: The axis applies to accounting software, but the evidence pack never mentions chart-of-accounts customization, account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions. Adjacent items such as custom fields, journal entries, and the general claim of API parity with the web client do not document this capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
